beats.narration: Her sister called her a jinx
beats.caption: Her sister called her a jinx.
beats.action: Vi, back turned, walks away into smoke; Powder on her knees reaching after her
beats.environment: smoky undercity street after the blast
beats.camera_move: slow push past Powder toward Vi
beats.lighting: toxic green smoke, orange fire rim

beats.narration: The crime lord who raised her called her perfect
beats.caption: Her sister called her a jinx. / The crime lord / who raised her called her perfect.
beats.action: Silco kneels, touches her face; she smiles through tears

beats.narration: Piltover is a shining city of inventors
beats.caption: who raised her called her perfect. / Piltover is a shining city of inventors.
beats.action: golden towers, bridges and airships in sunlight; crane down past them
beats.world_visual: Piltover: a shining city of towers and inventors

beats.narration: Beneath it lies Zaun the undercity
beats.caption: Beneath it lies Zaun, / the undercity: poor, poisoned and lawless.
beats.action: the camera keeps falling below the bridges into green smog and pipes
beats.camera_move: crane down through the smog layer
beats.world_visual: Zaun: the poor, poisoned undercity beneath it

beats.narration: poor poisoned and lawless
beats.caption: the undercity: poor, poisoned and lawless.
beats.action: crowded street: neon, pipes, a fight in an alley, chem-barons' thugs

beats.narration: Down there glowing crystals called hextech can power anything
beats.caption: the undercity: poor, poisoned and lawless. / Down there, glowing crystals / called hextech can power anything,
beats.action: a glowing blue crystal in a cracked case lights a whole machine
beats.world_visual: a glowing hextech crystal powering a machine

beats.narration: or blow it apart
beats.caption: called hextech can power anything, / or blow it apart.
beats.action: the crystal cracks; a flash blows a crate apart
beats.world_visual: the same crystal blowing a crate apart

beats.narration: Powder and her big sister Vi were orphans raised by Vander a retired fighter
beats.caption: or blow it apart. / Powder and her big sister, Vi, / were orphans, raised by Vander, a retired fighter.
beats.action: Vander lifts both girls onto his shoulders; they laugh

beats.narration: Her brother Mylo called her a jinx someone who ruins everything she touches
beats.caption: were orphans, raised by Vander, a retired fighter. / Her brother Mylo called her a jinx: / someone who ruins everything she touches.
beats.action: Mylo sneers and points; Powder's smile drops

beats.narration: Only Vi believed in her
beats.caption: Only Vi believed in her.
beats.action: Vi kneels, wipes her tear, bumps fists with her

beats.narration: Powder built little bombs shaped like monkeys
beats.caption: Only Vi believed in her. / Powder built little bombs shaped like monkeys.
beats.action: at her workbench: wires, a little monkey bomb with button eyes

beats.narration: None of them ever worked
beats.caption: None of them ever worked.
beats.action: she lights a fuse; the monkey fizzles with a sad puff; she slumps

beats.narration: Then a crime boss Silco captured Vander
beats.caption: None of them ever worked. / Then a crime boss, Silco, captured Vander.
beats.action: Silco's men drag Vander away in the rain

beats.narration: The kids went to save him and left Powder behind
beats.caption: The kids went to save him, / and left Powder behind.
beats.action: the three run across rooftops toward a warehouse; Powder left behind at the window

beats.narration: She followed them with a monkey bomb packed with hextech crystals
beats.caption: and left Powder behind. / She followed them with a monkey bomb, / packed with hextech crystals.
beats.action: follows with the monkey bomb, crystals glowing inside its belly
beats.lighting: blue crystal glow from the toy

beats.narration: This time it worked
beats.caption: This time, it worked.
beats.action: she throws the monkey through a broken window

beats.narration: The blast killed two of her brothers
beats.caption: The blast killed two of her brothers.
beats.action: a blue-white blast fills the warehouse; then falling ash and silence (no bodies shown)

beats.narration: Vander was lost
beats.caption: Vander was lost.
beats.action: Vander's empty mechanical gauntlet lies in the rubble

beats.narration: And Vi said it Mylo was right You're a jinx
beats.caption: And Vi said it. / Mylo was right. / You're a jinx.
beats.action: Vi turns on Powder, face wet, shouting

beats.narration: Then Vi was gone
beats.caption: You're a jinx. / Then Vi was gone.
beats.action: Vi is dragged off into the smoke by shadows; Powder alone

beats.narration: Alone in the smoke she ran into the arms of the man who started it all
beats.caption: Alone in the smoke, / she ran into the arms of the man / who started it all.
beats.action: Powder runs into Silco's arms; he kneels and holds her
beats.purpose: into the arms of the man who started it

beats.narration: Silco took her in
beats.caption: who started it all. / Silco took her in.
beats.action: looks over her head into the dark; a decision

beats.narration: He raised her as his daughter
beats.caption: Silco took her in. / He raised her as his daughter.
beats.action: time-lapse: she grows at his desk, drawing; the monkey drawings turn into weapons
beats.lighting: green glow, seasons through the window

beats.narration: Powder became Jinx brilliant broken and dangerous
beats.caption: Powder became Jinx: brilliant, broken, and dangerous.
beats.action: she turns to camera, grinning, a rocket launcher on her shoulder

beats.narration: Years later in a breakdown she shot him
beats.caption: Powder became Jinx: brilliant, broken, and dangerous. / Years later, in a breakdown, she shot him.
beats.action: the table: Jinx shaking, a gun; Silco reaching; flash — he falls (off-screen impact)
beats.camera_move: slow push then cut on the flash

beats.narration: Then she fired a rocket at the council of Piltover
beats.caption: Years later, in a breakdown, she shot him. / Then she fired a rocket / at the council of Piltover.
beats.action: fires a rocket; it streaks up toward the golden council tower

beats.narration: That explains her pain It doesn't excuse what she did
beats.caption: That explains her pain. / It doesn't excuse what she did.
beats.action: sits alone among broken toys, rocking; the monkey drawings on the wall

beats.narration: With his last breath Silco said he never would have given her up
beats.caption: With his last breath, / Silco said he never / would have given her up.
beats.action: he cups her face; she sobs
beats.purpose: the hidden truth: he loved her

beats.narration: Don't cry You're perfect
beats.caption: would have given her up. / Don't cry. / You're perfect.
beats.action: his last smile: 'Don't cry. You're perfect.'

beats.narration: Her sister called her a jinx
beats.caption: Her sister called her a jinx.
beats.action: memory: Vi walking away in the smoke (beat 1 framing)

beats.narration: A monster called her perfect
